entities.summary: Tom Dice (b. 1989-11-25, Eeklo) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Eeklo and Belgium. Known in the fields of belgium, composers & musicians, europe.
